SugarAI is an AI-native CRM platform built for B2B sales, marketing, and service teams that need more than a system of record — they need a system of action. Designed for precision selling, SugarAI transforms raw customer and prospect data into clear, guided next steps, so sellers always know where to focus, who to engage, and what to do next.
At the heart of the platform is AI that works continuously in the background — surfacing high-value opportunities, flagging pipeline risks before deals slip, and pulling together the right account context before every customer conversation. Rather than adding dashboards and complexity, SugarAI simplifies the selling experience: reps spend less time searching for information and more time closing business.
SugarAI is purpose-built for account-based industries with complex sales cycles, large product catalogs, and long-term customer relationships — including wholesale distribution, manufacturing, and professional services. Its deep integration with ERP systems means sales teams get a complete picture of each account, combining transactional back-office data with CRM intelligence to spot churn risks, reorder opportunities, and buying pattern changes that would otherwise go unnoticed.
For sales managers, SugarAI makes coaching easier by surfacing where deals are stalled and which reps need support — turning pipeline reviews into targeted, actionable conversations. For revenue operations teams, its no-code and low-code workflow configuration, combined with seamless integration across modern and legacy systems, means faster time to value and lower total cost of ownership.
Named a Leader in Sales Force Automation by Nucleus Research for 2026 and trusted by more than 4,000 companies across 120+ countries, SugarAI is backed by a community of over one million users. Customers consistently report significant improvements in sales productivity, forecast accuracy, pipeline growth, and customer retention after adopting the platform.
Whether you're evaluating AI-powered CRM software, sales automation tools, revenue intelligence platforms, or looking to replace a legacy CRM with something that actually drives results — SugarAI delivers intelligence that turns signals into action, at every stage of the customer lifecycle.

"Powerful SugarBPM Workflows and Surprisingly Accurate Sugar Predict 2.0 Scoring"

4/5

What do you like best about SugarCRM?

The standout feature for our team is the SugarBPM engine. Unlike other CRMs with basic “if/then” rules, Sugar lets us build complex, multi-step workflows that actually match our real-world sales process.

I’m also a huge fan of the new “Last Interaction” column in the list view. It sounds like a small UI update, but it has completely changed how our reps prioritize their daily outreach.

Additionally, Sugar Predict 2.0 AI has become surprisingly accurate at scoring leads based on external buyer intent signals we didn’t even know were available. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What do you dislike about SugarCRM?

The learning curve is definitely steeper than a tool like HubSpot. If you aren’t careful with your configurations in Sugar Studio, the UI can start to feel a bit cluttered and harder to navigate. We’ve also found that some of the deeper data queries in the Advanced Analytics module can be slow to load, especially when pulling multi-year reports. Lastly, pricing for the “Sell Premier” tier is a noticeable jump, so you really need to be using the AI features to justify the ROI. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.

What problems is SugarCRM solving and how is that benefiting you?

We used to struggle with “data silos” between our sales and support teams. After moving to a unified Sugar environment, our account managers can now see active support tickets directly in the Sugar Sell dashboard. This has helped us avoid several awkward sales calls where we might have tried to upsell a client who was still dealing with an open technical issue. Overall, it’s made our outreach more informed and has improved our renewal rate by roughly 12% over the last two quarters. Review collected by and hosted on G2.com.
